tagline: 100% dedicated to animal health for more than 50 years
hero_kpi_rationale: The company is increasing its R&D investments to sustain future organic growth, a key driver for long-term development in the animal health sector.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.explanation: Expenses dedicated to the research and development of new products and solutions.
kpis.description: R&D investments increased by over 10% to reach nearly €100 million in 2023, aimed at developing a pipeline of promising projects.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of sales of goods and services over a given period.
kpis.description: Revenue grew 4.9% at constant exchange rates and scope compared to 2022, reaching €1.247 billion.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth despite a challenging environment.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Consolidated gross margin is not explicitly mentioned in the provided text.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted EBIT margin (earnings before interest and taxes) divided by revenue.
kpis.description: The company achieved a historical profitability performance before R&D, with an adjusted EBIT margin of approximately 15%.
kpis.signal: Historical performance in terms of operating profitability.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The company's total headcount increased by 1.4% compared to the previous year, reaching 5,500 employees.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth to support expansion.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investment spending to acquire or upgrade physical assets.
kpis.description: Specific capital expenditure figures are not detailed in the provided text.

kpis.name: Pet Animal Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated by companion animals relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Sales related to companion animals represent 59% of total revenue, while farm animals account for 41%.
kpis.signal: Companion animals dominate sales with 59% of the portfolio.

kpis.name: Greenhouse Gas Emissions Reduction
kpis.explanation: Percentage reduction in greenhouse gas emissions (scopes 1 and 2) over a given period.
kpis.description: Greenhouse gas emissions (scopes 1 and 2) decreased by 4.7% over a three-year period.
kpis.signal: 4.7% reduction in GHG emissions over three years.

kpis.name: New Product Launches
kpis.explanation: Number or significance of new products launched into the market.
kpis.description: Two new products were launched in 2023: Cortotic for the treatment of acute otitis in dogs (awarded two innovation prizes) and Veterinary HPM Kidney & Joint for senior cats.
kpis.signal: Ongoing innovation in key areas with recognized awards.

kpis.name: Acquisitions Completed
kpis.explanation: Number and impact of companies acquired by the company for external growth.
kpis.description: Two strategic acquisitions were completed in 2023: the long-standing distributor in the Czech Republic and Globion, an Indian leader in poultry vaccines, strengthening presence in emerging markets.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion through external growth in key markets.

kpis.name: ESG Goals 2025 Achieved
kpis.explanation: Significant progress toward achieving the social responsibility goals set for 2025.
kpis.description: Most ESG goals set for 2025 were achieved several years ahead of schedule in 2023, including the creation of a dedicated ESG department and a full carbon footprint analysis.
kpis.signal: Significant progress on ESG commitments with establishment of a dedicated department.

risks.title: Dependence on transport concession regulation
risks.score_rationale: Major risk for VINCI: concessions (highways, airports) represent 7 Bn EUR in revenue and depend entirely on long-term contracts with public authorities. Moderate language but central position in strategy. Stable trend but structural.

risks.title: Complex Cobra IS integration and acquisition risks
risks.score_rationale: Cobra IS acquired end-2021 with 9 concession projects in development and presence in Iberia/Latin America. Integration described as 'powerful growth engine' but high operational complexity. Risk of unrealized synergies or integration cost overruns.

risks.title: International revenue concentration and geopolitical risks
risks.score_rationale: 47% of 2021 revenue outside France, operations in 120 countries. Cobra IS strengthens Iberia/Latin America presence. Moderate language but growing geopolitical exposure. Upward trend with accelerated internationalization.

risks.title: Energy transition and concession asset obsolescence
risks.score_rationale: Strategic pivot toward renewable energy and low-carbon mobility. Commitment to 40% CO2 reduction by 2030. Risk that existing concession portfolio (thermal highways) becomes obsolete or less profitable. Strong strategic language indicates major issue.

risks.title: Intense competition in construction and energy
risks.score_rationale: VINCI Construction global leader (26.3 Bn EUR revenue) but fragmented market with 280,000 job sites. VINCI Energies tripled revenue in 12 years but facing rising competition. Moderate language but implicit pricing pressure.

risks.title: Supply chain dependence and cost inflation
risks.score_rationale: 27.4 Bn EUR in annual purchases, 65% from SMEs. 280,000 concurrent job sites. Post-2021 material/energy inflation not mentioned but major structural risk. Upward trend with geopolitical tensions.

risks.title: Project risks and cost overruns
risks.score_rationale: VINCI Construction manages 280,000 job sites and complex projects (civil engineering, prestressing, geotechnics). Language on 'disciplined risk management' indicates known issue. Risk of budget overruns and schedule delays on major projects.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and digitalization of critical operations
risks.score_rationale: VINCI accelerating digital transformation (Leonard, tech innovation, 2,500 patents). Critical operations (concessions, energy) depend on IT systems. Moderate language but rising risk with digitization. Upward trend.
